expected_schema.health_medicine_schedule_slots:
CREATE TABLE `health_medicine_schedule_slots` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `health_medicine_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `local_time` char(5) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `timezone` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `starts_on` date NOT NULL,
  `ends_on` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_by` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_medicine_schedule_active` (`health_medicine_id`,`is_active`),
  KEY `idx_medicine_schedule_creator` (`created_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_medicine_schedule_creator` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_medicine_schedule_record` FOREIGN KEY (`health_medicine_id`) REFERENCES `health_medicines` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_medicine_schedule_time` CHECK (`local_time` regexp '^(0[0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_medicine_schedule_timezone` CHECK (char_length(`timezone`) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_medicine_schedule_active` CHECK (`is_active` in (0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_medicine_schedule_dates` CHECK (`ends_on` is null or `ends_on` >= `starts_on`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `health_medicine_schedule_checkoffs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `schedule_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `scheduled_on` date NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(7) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `medicine_label` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `recorded_by` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `recorded_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_medicine_checkoff_occurrence` (`schedule_id`,`scheduled_on`),
  KEY `idx_medicine_checkoff_actor` (`recorded_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_medicine_checkoff_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`recorded_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_medicine_checkoff_schedule` FOREIGN KEY (`schedule_id`) REFERENCES `health_medicine_schedule_slots` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_medicine_checkoff_state` CHECK (cast(`state` as char charset binary) in (cast('taken' as char charset binary),cast('skipped' as char charset binary)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
